experiment: controlled three-seed comparison of the complete btt_policy_obs_v3_entities observation package against the reproduced Phase K btt_policy_obs_v1 control
status: proposed; frozen only when the campaign manifest pins this file's sha256
question: Does the complete v3 observation package, taken together, let PPO learn more Mario Break the Targets from normal tick-0 starts than v1 at 3,072,000 policy transitions, everything else matched?
not_isolated: the arms differ in the whole observation package (geometry, agent state, action classes, target motion, projectiles, fixed scaling versus running normalisation, input width); no gate attributes an effect to one component, and nothing here tests why the Phase K v2 comparison gave no benefit

v3.initialisation: fresh models; the input shape (606) cannot load any v1 / v2 checkpoint; no pilot checkpoint, optimizer state or statistics is reused

v1.reuse_condition: the all-three-seed reproduction check (R1 pinned checkpoint digests and rows, R2 all 600 final evaluation episodes, R3 decision inputs) PASSED on the manifest's code fingerprint and executable; a failed check is an integrity problem: the campaign stops and diagnoses, and the control is never replaced by newly trained runs by this rule

pairing: seeds 0, 1, 2 paired by seed number; every per-seed quantity compares m7n_s{s}_v3 with m7g_s{s}_v1
matched: PPO of rl/configs/m7g: 3e-4, rollout 5,120 = 5 x 1,024, batch 512, 10 epochs, gamma 0.999, lambda 0.995, clip 0.2, ent_coef 0, vf_coef 0.5, max_grad_norm 0.5
N = 5 workers with one standby each (<= 10 game processes)
tick-0 starts only; no curriculum, prefix, anchor or archive
3,072,000 policy transitions per run; checkpoints every 102,400

the M7e / Phase K post-hoc evaluation: initial + 9 curve points + final; 100 stochastic + 100 deterministic at initial and final, 60 + 5 at curve points; evaluation seed 12345; frozen policy; btt_eval_metrics_v1; every native clear replayed from tick 0 on a fresh process
unmatched_by_design: input width 15 vs 606 and parameters 11,538 vs 87,186; the [64, 64] tanh heads are identical
v1 keeps VecNormalize running observation statistics (its contract); v3 keys are pre-scaled and not normalised (its contract)
evaluation_basis: the final checkpoint set of each run (3,072,000 transitions), evaluated post hoc from tick 0 with frozen parameters; the run's own initial checkpoint set (ckpt_000000000) for the learning gate

denominators.K: verified clears over the 200 final episodes of a run (100 stochastic + 100 deterministic); a clear counts only when its canonical native actions, replayed from tick 0 on a fresh process, reproduce completion_time_passed AND completion_input_tick exactly; a native clear that does not reproduce is an integrity problem
denominators.T: mean targets broken over the final stochastic episodes of a run that are not verified clears (exact Fraction; the 100 stochastic episodes of the final label, minus verified clears)
denominators.X: 1 if any of the 100 final stochastic episodes of a run entered the left region (live x < -2100, btt_eval_metrics_v1 first_left_entry) or broke target 1, 6 or 8 (M7f identity), else 0
denominators.G: T of the run's final label minus T of the same run's initial label (ckpt_000000000, 100 stochastic episodes), v3 only

conditions_any: the control reproduction check is missing, failed or bound to another code fingerprint / executable / rule
a v3 training run is not verified (identity, fresh start, provenance, rows, leak-free)
an evaluation label of either arm fails its verification (episode count, frozen statistics, tick-0 starts, metrics, artifacts)
a native clear of either arm is not reproduced by its replay
a v1 (control) label is incomplete or changed since the manifest
integrity_gate.action: stop; no decision is recorded; diagnose

conditions_any: fewer than three verified v3 runs
a v3 final or initial label with fewer than 100 stochastic or 100 deterministic episodes (finals) / 100 stochastic (initial)
a stopped, failed or partial v3 run (preserved, never resumed for the comparison)
incomplete.action: no decision; the arm is reported as incomplete, never as a failure or an inconclusive result

gates_in_order.name: first_clear
gates_in_order.condition: (sum_s K[v3][s] >= 1 and sum_s K[v1][s] == 0) or (K[v3][s] > K[v1][s] for every seed)
gates_in_order.action: preserve every verified clear and its checkpoint permanently; v3 becomes the Track 1 observation

gates_in_order.name: ceiling_broken
gates_in_order.condition: no gate 1; no control-clear guard; X[v3][s] == 1 in at least ceiling_seeds_min seeds and X[v1][s] == 0 in every seed
gates_in_order.action: v3 selected for the next milestone; the crossing episodes are replayed and documented

gates_in_order.name: better_targets
gates_in_order.condition: no gate 1 or 2; no control-clear guard; D[s] >= targets_diff_min in every seed
gates_in_order.action: v3 selected for the next milestone

gates_in_order.name: worse
gates_in_order.condition: no gate 1-3; D[s] <= -targets_diff_min in every seed
gates_in_order.action: v1 stays; v3 recorded as worse at this budget; no extension

gates_in_order.name: no_learning
gates_in_order.condition: no gate 1-4; G[s] <= 0 in at least no_learning_seeds_min seeds
gates_in_order.action: v1 stays; v3 recorded as not learning from scratch at this budget; the representation is re-examined before any further v3 run

gates_in_order.name: no_benefit
gates_in_order.condition: anything else (seed disagreement in sign, |D| below the threshold in some seed, a v1-only clear, ...)
gates_in_order.action: v1 stays the default; v3 stays available and documented; this rule unlocks no extension

label_precedence: gate 0 (integrity) is evaluated first and stops everything; then incompleteness; then gates 1-6 in order, and the FIRST gate whose condition holds decides; every later gate's condition is still evaluated and reported, never used
tie_handling: all comparisons are inclusive on exact integers or Fractions, never rounded floats; an equal clear count in both arms (including 0 = 0) is not gate 1; K[v3][s] > K[v1][s] is strict per seed; D[s] exactly 1/2 counts for gate 3 and exactly -1/2 for gate 4; G[s] exactly 0 counts as no learning; X ties (1 = 1) are not gate 2; a v1-only verified clear engages the control-clear guard
primary_outcome: gates 1-3 (success) are decided ONLY by normal tick-0 evaluation of frozen final checkpoints: a verified clear, a left-side entry / left-target break, or the paired target difference
improvement_over_control: gate 1 and gate 2 compare event counts per seed against the reproduced v1 control; gate 3 / 4 use the paired difference D of mean final targets with a symmetric threshold of 1/2 target per episode in every seed (no pooling, no averaging across seeds, so one seed cannot carry the decision)
progress_toward_tick0_clear: K is the clear itself; X is the ceiling (the three targets left of the tall wall that no policy has reached from tick 0); D is the ordinary target count. A success on gate 2 or 3 is progress, not a clear, and is reported as such

supporting_diagnostics_never_gating.T2: final stochastic tick-0 episodes with target 2 broken, per seed and pooled over 300 per arm (Phase K v1 control: 1, 0, 2 = 3 / 300); every tick-0 break is policy-initiated by construction, and no anchored or prefix evaluation exists in this campaign
supporting_diagnostics_never_gating.T2_break_context: for each target-2 break, its consumed tick and whether it fell within the M7l L definition (by the deadline with >= 5 static right targets), reported descriptively
supporting_diagnostics_never_gating.L_R: the M7l L and R counts (early target 2 with the statics; a seven-right sweep by the deadline), per seed
others: deterministic play: targets and collapse share (M7e definition)
per-checkpoint stochastic target curves of both arms
evaluation wall, peak processes, commit / physical minima

budget.v3_training: 3 x 3,072,000 policy transitions (hard maximum; no extension, no extra seed)
budget.evaluation: 3 x 985 episodes (740 stochastic + 245 deterministic per run) plus clear replays

decision_recording: decided once by rl/m7n_analysis.decide on the frozen rule; recorded in runs/m7n/campaign/_matrix/analysis_n3.json and copied to docs; never re-decided
not_claims: no claim about individual feature contributions
no claim about checkpoint transfer to other characters (Mario is the only validated action-class mapping)
the omitted ledge column is a stage-coverage limitation of this contract, not evidence that ledge information is unnecessary
a gate-2 or gate-3 success is not a clear
control_clear_guard: if sum_s K[v1][s] >= 1 and sum_s K[v3][s] == 0 (the control cleared from tick 0 and v3 never did), gates 2 and 3 cannot select v3; gates 4-6 are evaluated as usual (a worse or non-learning v3 is still recorded as such; otherwise the result is inconclusive and the v1 clear is reported)
